result.title: Cancellation-Free Constrained SquareCB for Safe Controller Selection
result.summary: We study constrained contextual bandits, in which a learner chooses one of $K$ actions in each round to minimize loss while keeping the expected cost of its play below a budget. Existing reductions to online regression weight the cost by a Lagrange multiplier learned from past constraint residuals, so slack in some rounds can offset violations in others. We instead run SquareCB proposed in \citep{foster2020beyond} with a rectified weight on the cost: it is zero when the estimated cost is within the budget, and otherwise just large enough to bring it back to the budget. Under realizability and Slater's condition with margin $δ$, the algorithm attains regret $O(\sqrt{KT\,\mathrm{Reg}_{\mathsf{Sq}}(T)}/δ)$ and cancellation-free violation $\sum_t(V_c^{p_t}-b)^+=O(\sqrt{KT\,\mathrm{Reg}_{\mathsf{Sq}}(T)})$, where $\mathrm{Reg}_{\mathsf{Sq}}$ is the error of the regression oracle. The same bounds hold when the budget must be met in every context, potentially adversarially chosen contexts. In controller selection for a safe-control-gym quadrotor and a BOPTEST building, the violation is 6 to 9 times lower than that of primal-dual and virtual-queue baselines, with a lower or comparable regret.

AI.brief_summary: 研究带预算约束的上下文 bandit，用对成本做修正加权的 SquareCB 替代拉格朗日乘子式约简，给出 regret 与不可抵消的违规界，并在四旋翼与楼宇控制选择任务上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「每轮违规不可由其他轮松弛抵消」的约束度量与预算内动作选择，可能为 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 的计算成本约束及过程性评价提供参照，但联系较远，需核查可迁移性。
